title: Strategy Pattern
overview: Define a family of algorithms, encapsulate each one, and make them interchangeable at runtime.
useCases: You have multiple ways to perform the same task and want to switch behaviours at runtime
You want to avoid large if/switch statements choosing between implementations
You want to add new algorithms without modifying existing code (Open/Closed Principle)
exampleUses: A navigation app that switches between fastest route, shortest route, and avoid-tolls strategies based on user preference
An e-commerce checkout that applies different discount strategies (percentage, flat rate, buy-one-get-one) without branching in the order logic
A compression tool that lets the user choose between ZIP, GZIP, or BZIP2 algorithms at runtime without changing the tool's core logic
